require_type_number.description: Flag to indicate whether password must contain numerical digit

require_type_lowercase.description: Flag to indicate whether password must contain lowercase letter

require_type_uppercase.description: Flag to indicate whether password must contain uppercase letter

require_type_symbol.description: Flag to indicate whether password must contain symbol (i.e. !@#$%^&*<>?)

min_characters_per_type.description: Minimum number of characters for each character type

min_changed_characters.description: Minimum number of changed characters for new passwords

history_count.description: Number of old passwords to remember

expire_time_days.description: Number of days password expires; a value of 0 means it never expires

session_timeout_minutes.description: Number of minutes to timeout the user session without activity
